column3: “those who perform the duties of” renders “keepers of the duty of.”
“the appointed duties” renders “the office of the duty,” and NASB supplies “involved.”
“toward the sunrise” renders a second “eastward,” and “the obligation” renders “the duty.”
“the command of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD” (also in verse 51).
“make a list of their names” renders “take the number of their names.”
“five shekels apiece, per head” renders “five, five shekels for the head”; NASB puts “the shekel is twenty gerahs” in parentheses.
